zh-CN.summary: Agent 交付物现在可以直接在会话中预览，工作台布局与应用更新体验也更加完整。

items.title: 在会话中直接预览 Agent 生成的交付物
items.detail: 最终回复里的本地 HTML、SVG、GIF、PNG、JPEG 与 WebP 文件链接会自动变成预览卡片，无需额外 MCP；重新打开会话仍可继续查看。

items.title: 应用更新现在展示双语结构化说明
items.detail: 设置页按新增、改进与修复组织更新内容，并支持展开长清单。

items.title: 工作台列布局与关闭动画更加自然
items.detail: 无横向溢出时列会自动填满空间；关闭列时仅在需要时重新分配宽度。

items.title: 强化 HTML 预览的静态安全边界
items.detail: 预览限制在当前工作区，禁用脚本、网络、表单与导航，并校验文件类型和大小。

en-US.summary: Agent deliverables can now be previewed directly in conversations, alongside a more polished Workbench layout and update experience.

items.title: Preview Agent-generated deliverables directly in conversations
items.detail: Local HTML, SVG, GIF, PNG, JPEG, and WebP links in final responses become preview cards without another MCP, and remain available when the conversation is reopened.

items.title: App updates now include localized structured release notes
items.detail: Settings organizes update details into New, Improved, and Fixed sections with expandable long lists.

items.title: More natural Workbench column layout and close animations
items.detail: Columns fill available space when there is no horizontal overflow, and closing a column only redistributes width when needed.

items.title: Stronger static security boundaries for HTML previews
items.detail: Previews stay within the current workspace, disable scripts, network access, forms, and navigation, and validate file type and size.
